description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class PaymentTypeNotFoundException used for indicating that a specific payment type was not found within the application. It extends a base exception class and provides a constructor that accepts an ID to generate an informative error message.

classes.name: PaymentTypeNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a specific payment type could not be found, extending the platform's resource not found exception.

methods.name: PaymentTypeNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that takes an ID and constructs an exception with a specific error message indicating the payment type with that ID does not exist.

calls: super("error.msg.payment.type.invalid", "PaymentType with " + id + " does not exist", id)
